duration_and_trial_units.noise: one seed x generator, 20 seconds at 250 Hz
duration_and_trial_units.packet: one seed x noise level, 30 seconds at 250 Hz
duration_and_trial_units.stationary: one rate x frequency x phase, 30 seconds

failure_policy: retain failed settings and exclude failed branches from future confirmatory use; no threshold tuning after freeze
freeze_revisions: Specify optional notch Q=30 before first detector output; initial freeze retained in scratch.
Correct analytic chirp inflection roots from phase crossings to x-second-derivative zeros and specify exact stochastic generator; earlier freeze retained.
Predeclare 10 of 100 seeds per no-oscillator generator for bounded cycle/burst scoring; all 100 retain waveform scoring.

Correct scoring-edge censoring after a retained failed battery: evaluate stationary truth at least four samples beyond measured guard, allow two-sample pairing across the evaluation edge, and exclude unmatched scoring-edge rows. Detector settings and two-sample hard gate unchanged.
Add analytic raised-cosine packet derivative truth so noisy packet missed/extra landmarks and signed bias have a fixed denominator before final scoring.
Review R1 correction before rerun: label chirp roots by analytic first/second derivative crossing; keep the same analytic roots and detector parameters.

Review R1 correction before rerun: pair truth and detection with context, censor each crossing-edge pair on both sides, and require matched+missed=eligible truth and matched+extra=eligible detection; preserve raw core and censored counts.

Review R1 coverage amendment before rerun: score cycles and both burst definitions for all original seeds 0-99 of each no-oscillator generator; retain the earlier 10-seed receipt separately. No new noise realizations or threshold changes.

hard_gates.matching: one-to-one maximum-cardinality minimum-total-absolute-error, explicit overflow and unknown-clock abstention, null empty-empty

measurements.matching: directional fractions, 2m/(nA+nB), signed/absolute lag, before/after counts, common duration
measurements.noise_and_artifact: accepted derivative landmarks / guarded valid minute; cycle and burst detections labeled false only for no-oscillator controls, reported per generator, library, band, and 100 fixed trials
measurements.nonstationary: signed bias, missed/extra counts and boundary error by fixture
measurements.packets: hit if burst interval intersects known packet; false burst if no intersection, with fixed 10 trials per noise level
measurements.stationary: max native sample localization error by family with exact denominator

real_smoke: only input/exposed-fixture.npz after every synthetic hard gate passes; curator JSON remains outside numeric discovery

review_r1_scoring_contract.counts: retain raw core, eligible and crossing-edge-censored counts separately
review_r1_scoring_contract.edge_rule: a pair with exactly one member in the core is censored on both sides; matched pairs require both members in core
review_r1_scoring_contract.pairing: one-to-one by family and polarity/direction within tolerance using context rows

sample_convention: t=n/fs, n=0..N-1; nearest truth index=floor(t*fs+0.5); intervals half-open

stationary_scoring_edge.reason: ensure root and detector may differ by2 samples at evaluation edge without artificial missed/extra

targeted_fixtures.clock_reset: two distinct 15s timing segments with second segment resetting to0; no matching across segments
targeted_fixtures.gap: 30s 8Hz sine; invalid samples[3000:3250); whole support cannot span
targeted_fixtures.native_reference: four native 250Hz contacts: x0=20sin(2pi8t), x1=10sin(2pi8t+pi/5), x2=5sin(2pi5t), x3=3sin(2pi5t+pi/3); compare original and common-average references, and x0-x1 pair
targeted_fixtures.plateau_direct_sign: unit derivative arrays: adjacent opposite signs, maximal zero run, unqualified one-sample flank
targeted_fixtures.spike: one +100uv sample at15s on zero baseline
